title: Schedule of Field Service Surcharges Appended to the Custom Application and Field Services Agreement
content:
This schedule sets, for each programme of Custom Application and Field Services, the field size at or below which the small acre surcharge applies, the sum or share each class of surcharge carries, and the basis on which several surcharges combine on one work order.

## Schedule A: surcharge figures by programme

| Programme | Small acre threshold (acres) | Small acre surcharge (USD) | Point row surcharge (percent of the acre charge) | Out-of-window surcharge (percent of the acre charge) | Night application surcharge (USD) | Fly-on surcharge (USD per acre) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 20 | 65.00 | 10 | 0 | 120.00 | 8.75 |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 20 | 65.00 | 10 | 12 | 120.00 | 8.75 |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 15 | 55.00 | 8 | 10 | 100.00 | 8.00 |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 15 | 55.00 | 8 | 10 | 100.00 | 8.00 |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 10 | 0.00 | 0 | 8 | 0.00 | 7.50 |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 20 | 75.00 | 12 | 15 | 150.00 | 0.00 |

Footnote (i): the small acre threshold is the field size at or below which the small acre surcharge applies, so a field standing exactly at the figure is within the threshold.

Footnote (ii): the point row surcharge and the out-of-window surcharge are each a share of the acre charge raised on that work order. The small acre surcharge and the night application surcharge are flat sums. The fly-on surcharge is a sum per acre.

## Schedule B: stacking basis

| Programme | Basis on which several surcharges combine on one work order |
|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | surcharges of different classes add |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | surcharges of different classes add |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | surcharges of different classes add |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | surcharges of different classes add |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | surcharges of different classes add |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | surcharges of different classes add |

Every programme of Custom Application and Field Services stacks on the same basis: surcharges of different classes add together rather than the largest of them being taken.
